messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: billing-metering pulse gap detected for metering-emitter pipeline. Observed 00:54–01:12 UTC gap on emitter-3 -> aggregator. 3 customers received provisional overage flags. Runbook: https://internal.runbook/redwood/metering-pulse
jordan (oncall): ack — oncall here. paging infra + billing. assigning triage lead: maria
jordan (oncall): quick checks: are consumers showing lag? any recent deploys to emitters?
maria (billing): seeing token delta in the ledger vs emitter stream. tokens_emitted +12% vs ledger_count over the last 1h. provisional flags auto-triggered. sample emitter log:
```
{"emitter":"emitter-3","last_seq":102345,"time":"2026-03-18T01:07:12Z","status":"ok"}
```
alex (infra): consumer lag spike on metering-topic-2. running: `kafka-consumer-groups --describe --group billing-agg --bootstrap-server kafka.prod:9092`
alex (infra): sample output (trimmed):
```
GROUP           TOPIC           PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG
billing-agg     metering-topic  2          124500          245000          120500
```
jordan (oncall): noted. was there a deploy around 00:58? I see deploy-2026-03-18-00:58 to emitter service. maria, any schema or avro changes?
maria (billing): no schema changes. deploy was config tweak to batching/window. suspect batching change increased producer burst and caused aggregator retry fan-out -> duplicate counting.
ben (cs): @channel CS notified for the 3 affected accounts (acct-1234, acct-5678, acct-9999). Sending preliminary message and holding on billing until we confirm root cause.
alex (infra): plan: 1) enable fallback aggregator (agg-fallback) to stop double-counting 2) restart emitter-3 3) throttle alerts to stop customer-facing overage emails. executing steps now.
alex (infra): executing restart: `ssh infra@emitter-3 sudo systemctl restart billing-emitter@3`
alex (infra): restart returned quickly, logs show emitter reconnect and reduced burst. monitoring consumer lag to catch up.
maria (billing): after emitter restart + fallback, ledger vs emitter diff dropped from +12% to +1.2% over last 10m. overage flags auto-cleared for acct-1234. continuing monitoring.
jordan (oncall): great. please hold any billing invoices until we have final reconciliation. alex, can you run the backfill once lag is < 10k?
alex (infra): yes — will run backfill: `internal-backfill --topic metering-topic --group billing-agg --since 2026-03-18T00:50:00Z` once consumer lag < 10k.
maria (billing): queued backfill; estimate 30–45m to reconcile. will run reconciliation job and reconcile provisional flags. creating short mitigation playbook entry in incident doc.
ben (cs): CS update: sent holding notice to affected customers; offering temporary credit if final reconciliation shows over-billing. keeping customers updated via triage channel.
incident-bot: NOTE: If unresolved >30m escalate to eng-sre@pager and post to #all-hands.
jordan (oncall): posted status page: "Intermittent billing delay and provisional overage flags affecting a subset of customers; engineering investigating."
maria (billing): post-restart snapshot: token variance now within normal bounds (<=2%). will run full reconciliation and generate short report by EOD.
alex (infra): backfill kicked at 1763530400; initial progress: consumer lag dropped to 6k, backfill running at ~5k msg/s.
jordan (oncall): monitoring for 2 hours; if final variance <=1% and no customer complaints, we'll close. Otherwise open postmortem.
maria (billing): follow-up: after backfill, final delta = +0.3% (within noise). all provisional overage flags cleared; CS notified and offered credit to acct-5678 while we finish audit.
ben (cs): customers acknowledged the hold message, appreciate quick response.
jordan (oncall): thanks all — marking incident resolved in channel but leaving ticket open for postmortem doc with root cause: batching/config change -> bursty producer -> aggregator retry/duplication. action items: add canary for batching config, rate-limit producer bursts, add stronger dedupe in aggregator.
alex (infra): will file PR for producer throttling and a deploy checklist to include metering smoke tests.
maria (billing): will author reconciliation runbook and add automated alert to detect emitter bursts before overage flags trigger.
jordan (oncall): closing thread. if anything flares up ping oncall. :white_check_mark:
